options.content:
**Coraza's own `[hostname "..."]` is the envoy pod IP**, not the site that was attacked - it is the server address of the connection. The requested host comes from local rule `10020`, which emits one extra line per flagged request carrying `host=` and the anomaly score. It shares the transaction's `unique_id` with the rule alerts, which is how the panels below join the two.

**`[client "..."]` is the TCP peer** - a cloudflared pod IP on `envoy-external`. The real client is the first element of `x-forwarded-for` on the matching access-log line.

**In `SecRuleEngine DetectionOnly` the Prometheus panels stay flat at zero** - `waf_filter.tx.interruptions` only counts an actual interrupt. The log panels are the truth during the detection soak.

Rule `949110`/`949111` is the CRS anomaly evaluation: a hit there is a request that *would* be blocked once the engine is flipped to `On`. LAN sources are exempted by local rules 10001/10002 and never appear here.

panels.title: Detections
panels.description: Coraza alert lines in the selected range.

targets.expr: kubernetes.pod_namespace:network kubernetes.pod_labels.gateway.envoyproxy.io/owning-gateway-name:~"^$gateway$" _msg:Coraza -"WAF request context" | stats count() hits

panels.title: Would be blocked
panels.description: CRS rule 949110 - inbound anomaly score over threshold.

targets.expr: kubernetes.pod_namespace:network kubernetes.pod_labels.gateway.envoyproxy.io/owning-gateway-name:~"^$gateway$" _msg:Coraza -"WAF request context" | extract '[id "<rule_id>"]' | filter rule_id:="949110" or rule_id:="949111" | stats count() hits

kubernetes.pod_namespace:network kubernetes.pod_labels.gateway.envoyproxy.io/owning-gateway-name:~"^$gateway$" "WAF request context" | extract '[data "host=<host> score=<score>"]' | stats count_uniq(host) hosts

panels.title: Requests inspected /s
panels.description: Every transaction the wasm VM saw, including allowlisted ones. Envoy Gateway emits coraza's proxy-wasm counters unprefixed, not under envoy_wasmcustom_.

targets.expr: kubernetes.pod_namespace:network kubernetes.pod_labels.gateway.envoyproxy.io/owning-gateway-name:~"^$gateway$" _msg:Coraza -"WAF request context" | extract '[id "<rule_id>"]' | stats by (rule_id) count() hits

panels.title: Top rules - the false-positive tuning list
panels.description: Work this to zero legitimate hits before flipping SecRuleEngine to On.

targets.expr: kubernetes.pod_namespace:network kubernetes.pod_labels.gateway.envoyproxy.io/owning-gateway-name:~"^$gateway$" _msg:Coraza -"WAF request context" | extract '[id "<rule_id>"]' | extract '[msg "<msg>"]' | extract '[unique_id "<uid>"]' | join by (uid) (kubernetes.pod_namespace:network kubernetes.pod_labels.gateway.envoyproxy.io/owning-gateway-name:~"^$gateway$" "WAF request context" | extract '[data "host=<host> score=<score>"]' | extract '[unique_id "<uid>"]' | fields uid, host) | stats by (host, rule_id, msg) count() hits | sort by (hits desc) | limit 25

panels.title: Top attacked hosts and paths

targets.expr: kubernetes.pod_namespace:network kubernetes.pod_labels.gateway.envoyproxy.io/owning-gateway-name:~"^$gateway$" _msg:Coraza -"WAF request context" | extract '[uri "<uri>"]' | extract '[unique_id "<uid>"]' | join by (uid) (kubernetes.pod_namespace:network kubernetes.pod_labels.gateway.envoyproxy.io/owning-gateway-name:~"^$gateway$" "WAF request context" | extract '[data "host=<host> score=<score>"]' | extract '[unique_id "<uid>"]' | fields uid, host) | stats by (host, uri) count() hits | sort by (hits desc) | limit 25

panels.description: Joined to rule 10020's context line on unique_id, so the host is the one the client asked for.

panels.title: Top external source addresses (all requests)
panels.description: First element of x-forwarded-for on the access log, i.e. the real client. Watch for the home WAN IP here - those are LAN devices bypassing blocky, and they are NOT exempted by rules 10001/10002.

targets.expr: kubernetes.pod_namespace:network kubernetes.pod_labels.gateway.envoyproxy.io/owning-gateway-name:~"^$gateway$" | extract_regexp "^(?P<client_ip>[^,]+)" from "x-forwarded-for" | stats by (client_ip) count() hits | sort by (hits desc) | limit 25

panels.title: Interruptions by rule - blocking mode only
panels.description: Flat at zero while SecRuleEngine is DetectionOnly. Labels come from the stats_config.stats_tags patch on EnvoyProxy/envoy-waf.

targets.expr: kubernetes.pod_namespace:network kubernetes.pod_labels.gateway.envoyproxy.io/owning-gateway-name:~"^$gateway$" _msg:Coraza -"WAF request context" | extract '[id "<rule_id>"]' | extract '[msg "<msg>"]' | extract '[severity "<severity>"]' | extract '[uri "<uri>"]' | extract '[client "<client>"]' | extract '[unique_id "<uid>"]' | join by (uid) (kubernetes.pod_namespace:network kubernetes.pod_labels.gateway.envoyproxy.io/owning-gateway-name:~"^$gateway$" "WAF request context" | extract '[data "host=<host> score=<score>"]' | extract '[unique_id "<uid>"]' | fields uid, host)
